notes: RRB Group D (Level 1) cutoffs are **zone-wise** — each Railway Recruitment Board publishes its own. Minimum qualifying marks in CBT are fixed nationally (UR/EWS 40%, OBC/SC/ST 30%); the actual shortlisting cutoffs sit well above and swing by zone and vacancy count. Rows below are official baseline + representative zone figures (normalized scores).

cbt.note: Qualifying ≠ selection: actual cutoffs run much higher.

cbt.source: RRB Secunderabad official cutoff reproduction (anilsiriti/Testbook compilations)
cbt.note: Illustrative zone; every RRB's table differs. Older-cycle zone lows (e.g. Ajmer UR ~40) show how vacancy count moves the bar.

cutoffs.note: Pass/fail physical efficiency test — no marks cutoff; candidates many times the vacancy count per zone clear CBT and face PET
Final shortlist = CBT merit among PET-qualified candidates, zone-wise and category-wise, in each RRB's DV notice
